component.name: link2linux
component.summary: Connect your Android phone to your Linux desktop

description.p: link2linux shares your Android phone with your Linux desktop, directly over your own network: no account, no cloud.

ul.li: See your phone's notifications on the desktop, reply to them and dismiss them
Copy on one device and paste on the other
Take calls through the computer over Bluetooth
See the phone's battery and signal, and make it ring to find it
Browse the phone's recent photos and save the ones you want
Show the phone's screen in a window, and control it if you allow it

description.p: Every connection uses mutual TLS 1.3 between the two devices you paired with a QR code. The phone needs the link2linux Android app.
